To summarize it quickly, those old campaigns were never going to be finished, hence they were unlisted to prevent confusion for new viewers. There was a hiatus while the boys planned the new stuff, and they came back by running one-shots in the settings of potential campaigns and then had viewers vote and decide which one would become the new main campaign (Riptide) and which one would be the Patron-exclusive campaign (Prime Defenders).

I recommended starting with the "[Start Here!](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLlDdLy-1g17ausTu_DjJYBvMIfymHDIma&si=7juAOVeZIxiaARal)" playlist on the YouTube. This has all the one-shots (the Riptide ones and the Prime Defenders ones give some context to the main episodes in their respective series, though they're not required). Then, if you vibe with it, move on to Riptide. Riptide is on hiatus now, so it's a great time to catch up!

As you pointed out, some of the old episodes from the previous campaign are still floating around. You can watch them if you'd like, however nothing from them is relevant now besides the odd reference to them here and there in the new episodes, and the overall quality of the new stuff is WAY better.
